questions.qtext:
Consider the following statements:
1. Visual flight rule (VFR) prevails when the weather condition is good and pilot requires air traffic control during operation.
2. Instrumental flight rule (IFR) prevails when the visibility is inadequate during night time or due to fog.
3. Compared to IFR, runway capacity under VFR is higher.
Which of the above statements are CORRECT?
questions.solution:
(b)
VFR prevails when the weather condition is good and pilot can manage with visual aid during
operation without the requirement of air traffic control.

questions.qtext:
The maximum friction offered by pavement surface or the skid resistance depends upon
1. Type of pavement.
2. Speed of vehicle.
3. Condition of tyre.
4. Brake efficiency.
Which of the following statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(d)
Maximum friction offered by pavement depends upon:
• Load and tyre pressure
• Type of skid
• Speed of vehicle
• Temperature of tyre and pavement
• Type of pavement
• Condition of tyre
• Brake efficiency

questions.qtext: Which of the following statements regarding bitumen is incorrect?

options.text: Tar is the viscous liquid obtained when organic materials such as wood and coal are carbonized or destructively distilled.
Cut-back bitumen is the bitumen whose viscosity has been reduced by a volatile diluent.
Bitumen emulsion is the liquid product in which substantial amount of bitumen is suspended in a finely divided condition in aqueous medium and stabilized by means of one or more suitable materials.
Cutback bitumen can be used in wet weather, even when it is raining,

questions.solution:
(d)
Bitumen emulsion can be used in wet weather even when it is raining. Also emulsion have been used in soil stabilization particularly for the stabilization of sand in desert areas.
